# Promise: you can rewrite, trace and recover history without leaving the app — the three promise scenarios (Rewrite, Trace, Recover) run end to end with no shell step, and each of the 29 journeys is walked at or under the note's count (TESTING.md "M7 acceptance").

# m7-contact-sheet-captions.tsv and re-run instead.

# 75 captures in all, in ticket order.

# These are character-grid captures (pyte/TestBackend), not pixels:
# colour is never verifiable from this file. Judge colour only in a
# real terminal, never from a capture (CLAUDE.md rule 5).

# Scroll once: each capture is delimited by a heading naming its
# file (docs/shots/<name>) and what right looks like for it.

# unverified).
#
# What right looks like: `. ⏎ y` on `fix` from `main`, `f.txt` line 5
# edited and staged, `fix` changed line 7. git could not put the staging
# back on `fix`'s tree, so the edits came back unstaged.
#  - The cursor on `fix`, now HEAD.

#    kept: f.txt · u undoes it, staging included` at 187; at 80 `your
